headlines: TWO-MILE WOODEN BRIDGE COMPLETED BY JOHN COLLINS OPENED MIAMI BEACH IN 1913
HOW A 1913 WOODEN BRIDGE OPENED MIAMI BEACH
THE HISTORIC 1913 WOODEN BRIDGE THAT SPARKED THE DEVELOPMENT OF MIAMI BEACH
posts.headline: TWO-MILE WOODEN BRIDGE COMPLETED BY JOHN COLLINS OPENED MIAMI BEACH IN 1913
posts.article: In 1913, a two-mile wooden bridge opened Miami Beach to the world. Built by John Collins, the completed bridge marked a defining moment in local history. Miami Beach was developed after the completion of this two-mile wooden bridge. When John Collins completed the wooden span in 1913, the structure opened Miami Beach and sparked its development. The year 1913 remains a major milestone across our area. The completion of the two-mile wooden bridge built by John Collins opened Miami Beach, leading directly to the development that followed.
